text.en: Dog owners across south east London commend trainer Georgi for her patient, insightful, and generous approach to canine care. Reviewers emphasize that she takes time to understand each dog's distinct personality, offering practical guidance to owners and managing group walks with skill. Clients describe her as an exceptionally reliable and trusted behaviourist.

Clients emphasize the deep care and understanding shown towards rescue dogs, reactive pets, and young puppies. Reviewers report that dogs return from adventure walks thoroughly exercised, content, and enriched. Owners of nervous dogs particularly value the calm, positive reinforcement techniques that help pets feel secure and valued in group environments.

Pet owners report impressive behavioural improvements in reactive and anxious rescue dogs within just a few coaching sessions. Reviewers note that dogs learn to focus on owner cues, stop lunging at triggers, and socialise politely on group walks. Long-term clients also credit puppy classes and structured walking with developing well-mannered companions.

q.en: What services does Cwtches Dog provide in South East London?

a.en: The practice provides structured group adventure walks, puppy foundation classes, and private behavioural coaching sessions.

q.en: Can Cwtches Dog help with reactive or nervous rescue dogs?

a.en: Yes, clients report rapid progress with rescue and reactive dogs learning to socialise and listen around triggers within a few sessions.

q.en: How are group adventure walks organised?

a.en: Georgi and her team match dogs carefully by temperament and energy level, ensuring enriching, safe, and fulfilling outings.

q.en: How do clients describe the pricing and value of services?

a.en: Pet parents describe the puppy classes, behavioural packages, and regular walks as offering exceptionally good value.
